_readme: Second read of Palo Verde College's program maps (S347, SkyTrellis). Read 1 (run 37810862182) found guides.paloverde.edu does not resolve; it still does not (2026-10-08). A search restricted to libguides.com finds the same guide, "PVC Pirates Pathways - LibGuides at Palo Verde College", at the college's own LibGuides address, paloverde.libguides.com/pathways. A search restricted to paloverde.edu indexes two of its pages with a semester layout: Computer Information Systems ("your 2-year printable pathway", four semesters and a summer) and Building Construction Technology (four semesters). The guide is not refused; its custom name lapsed. This read opens the guide's home, its tabs and those two pages, and prints any map, pathway or PDF link.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses, read on one map the index links.
